plugins.name: dev-skills
plugins.description: Autonomous dev workflow in one plugin: 19 skills (design, api design, openapi spec, mermaid diagrams, github actions, ui prototype, plan, implement, review, QA, debug, refactor, perf, release, clean up, git safety), 4 sub-agents (researcher, implementer, fixer, tester), and the /loop orchestrator command — each skill with a lite/full/ultra delivery mode.
